verdict.rationale: Superhuman docs clearly describe automatic follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if no reply is received, complete with pre-written drafts and nudges timed to open-rates (superhuman-docs-6, superhuman-docs-36, superhuman-docs-25, superhuman-docs-31). However, the classic 'snooze' capability (temporarily hiding a conversation until a chosen time) is never explicitly documented in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit snooze/remind-me-later scheduling documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of the follow-up reminder feature.
